sourceEn.description:
Möller’s Omega-3 jelly fish contains omega-3 fatty acids, which help maintain normal brain function and vision. The jelly fish also contain the fat-soluble vitamin D, which contributes to the normal function of the immune system and is needed for normal growth and development of bone in children. The jelly fish are without added sugar, with a natural aroma.
The recommended daily dose from three years of age is two jelly fish.
Ingredients: Sweeteners (xylitol, sorbitol), fish oil concentrate, purified water, gelatine (bovine), acidity regulator (trisodium citrate), antioxidant (malic acid), natural flavourings, colour (carminic acid), vitamin (cholecalciferol).

Vitamin D contributes to normal absorption of calcium and phosphours and is needed for normal growth and development of bone in children. Vitamin D contributes to the normal function of the immune system.
**The beneficial effect is achieved with daily consumption of 250 mg of DHA.
**The beneficial effect is achieved with daily consumption of 250 mg of EPA and DHA.

sourceEn.description:
Möller’s Total is a dietary supplement composed of nutrients with proven effectiveness and gives you a good supplement of omega-3, vitamins and minerals. These are nutrients that your body needs and that help maintain a normal immune system. Möller’s Total contains 28 daily doses. A daily dose consists of an omega-3 capsule and a multivitamin tablet. To help you remember your daily dose, we have marked the tray with the days of the week.
The capsule in Möller’s Total contains the omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA, which contribute to the normal function of the heart**. DHA contributes to the normal function of the brain and vision*. The tablet in Möller’s Total contains a number of vitamins and minerals, including Vitamin D, which contributes to the normal function of the immune system, as well as the maintenance of the normal bone structure.
*A beneficial effect is achieved with a daily intake of 250 mg DHA.
** A beneficial effect is achieved with a daily intake of 250 mg DHA and EPA.
The recommended daily dose for adults is one tablet and one capsule.
Not suitable for children or pregnant and lactating women or 1-2 weeks before the planned operation. Caution is recommended with the concurrent use of medicine. Cease intake for 2-3 weeks after continuous intake for 3 months.

Omega-3 capsules: Fish oil concentrate (triglycerides), gelatine (bovine), humectant (glycerol), cholecalciferol, antioxidant (tocopherol-rich extract)
Multivitamin tablet: Bulking agents (calcium phosphate, microcrystalline cellulose, cross-linked sodium carboxymethylcellulose), magnesium (magnesium hydroxide), ginseng root extract (Panax ginseng C.A.
